images.title: Conclave field scholar
images.card: Unit, cost 3. Zap: instead of attacking, deal 1 damage to an enemy 2 tiles away.
images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.continuity: Her face, long dark braid and build from the sheet. The navy reinforced short coat with its steel side plates and ochre sleeves, the measuring staff with its three-pronged brass head, and the leather folio.
images.brief: On a high, windswept survey path above a valley, the scholar has stopped mid-measurement, folio tucked under one arm. Without fully looking up from her notes, she has flicked the brass prongs of her measuring staff toward something off-screen RIGHT, and a small, quick snap of blue-white light has just left them, crossing a short gap and fading. The zap is deliberately modest: a bright crackle about the length of a forearm, not a beam. Her expression is mildly irritated at the interruption, not heroic. Wind pulls at her coat and a loose strand of hair. A few survey stakes and a cairn imply the place. Cool blues and slate greys, with the brass and her ochre sleeves as the warm notes.

images.title: Harmonic wardwright
images.card: Unit, cost 4. Ranged. Resonance: its attacks also deal 1 to each enemy next to the target.
images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.continuity: His face, close-cropped hair and beard, and build from the sheet. The blue-enamel breastplate, the long navy coat, and the brass stringed gauntlet on his right forearm.
images.brief: An offensive moment. The wardwright stands on a low grassy rise, turned to the LEFT, his gauntleted hand thrust forward with its strings visibly vibrating. Down the slope, where his attack has landed, a ring of blue-violet resonance bursts outward through an old drystone field wall, throwing broken stones aside. Three enemy soldiers at the wall, small, loosely painted and secondary, are knocked off their feet in different directions by the same ring: one attack, several people hit. His stance is braced and certain, a scholar who has become a fighter, not a robed mage posing. Warm amber grass and long shadows, with the cool violet burst as the one strong contrast. Nothing is aimed at the viewer.

images.title: Brightlance
images.card: Spell, cost 3. Deal 2 damage to an enemy unit, then push it 1 tile.
images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.continuity: The same harmonic wardwright as the unit card: his face, beard, blue-enamel breastplate, navy coat and brass stringed gauntlet.
images.brief: Inside a dark stone gatehouse passage at night, the wardwright drives his open right hand forward, the gauntlet's strings pulled taut. From his palm a narrow, solid-looking lance of blue and violet light TEARS forward to the RIGHT in a fast streak: it is clearly in motion, with a bright leading point, a trail breaking into crackling edges, and the air rippling in its wake. It is a lance of light, not a stone and not a lightning fork. At the right edge of the frame, small and secondary, an enemy's raised shield is being shoved backward by the impact, the figure behind it loosely painted and staggering. The spell's cold light falls across his face, beard and breastplate and throws hard shadows up the arch. Deep blue-black, electric blue and violet, with one warm note from a distant torch.
references: reference-library-2026-11-06/magic-and-craft-2026-11-08/01-harmonic-wardwright.png: continuity for this character, his face, breastplate and gauntlet

images.title: Woven ward
images.card: Enchantment, cost 3. Enchant one of your units: it ignores the next 4 damage, then the ward is used up.
images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.continuity: The field loom's design: dark wooden frame with brass corner fittings, three spools of blue-violet light, the side crank, the navy cloth cover and the paper pattern strip.
images.brief: In the trampled yard of a camp at first light, the field loom stands on the lowered tailgate of a cart. A young Artificer, sleeves rolled, turns its crank with real effort, watching the work. A sheet of translucent blue-violet weave has just come off the frame and is settling over the shoulders and back of a soldier in a plain gambeson who has stepped up to receive it, turned to the LEFT toward where the line is forming off-screen. He looks down at the ward on his arm, uncertain and impressed. The weave is soft and faintly patterned, like light-made cloth, and fades at its edges. Muted greys and browns of the camp, a few loosely painted tents, with the ward as the brightest thing in the scene.
references: reference-library-2026-11-06/magic-and-craft-2026-11-08/02-spellwright-field-loom.png: continuity for the loom and its ward

images.title: Enchanter's quench
images.card: Enchantment, cost 2. Enchant one of your units: +1 attack, and its attacks ignore Guard and other damage reduction.
images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.continuity: The rough-hewn stone quenching trough, the smith's iron tongs, and the plain straight blade whose steel takes on a deep blue inner light as it is quenched.
images.brief: A close, downward view into a stone quenching trough in a dim workshop. A smith's scarred forearms and leather apron enter from the upper left, his tongs plunging a plain straight blade into the dark water. Where the steel meets the water it flares with a deep blue, crystalline inner light that spreads up the blade as it cools, and a column of steam boils up, lit from below. Ripples and bubbles break the surface. His face is only partly in frame at the top edge, intent, loosely painted. The magic stays inside the steel: no beams, threads or runes. Near-black stone and water, warm forge-orange spill from off-screen, and the cold blue of the blade.
references: reference-library-2026-11-06/magic-studies-round-04-2026-11-08/05-enchanters-quench.png: the trough, tongs and the blade's blue light; a new, closer composition

images.title: Rime drake
images.card: Unit, cost 4. Flying. Freeze: the unit it attacks can't move on its next turn.
images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.continuity: The drake's anatomy from the sheet: horse-sized, pale grey and cream scales with darker mottling, backswept horns, frosted wing edges and a lean, long-tailed body.
images.brief: Over a shallow river ford in deep winter, the rime drake is landing on a snowy bank, wings still half spread, its whole body in frame and its neck stretched LEFT as it exhales a dense, low cloud of freezing breath across the water. Where the breath passes, the ford is freezing solid in a spreading white bloom, locking around the legs of an enemy rider's horse caught mid-crossing. The rider and horse are small, loosely painted and secondary, the horse straining, unhurt but stuck. The drake is a wild animal acting on its own, not anyone's mount. Its breath is condensation, rime and pale crystal, with no glow, apparatus or energy cords. Pale gold sun, blue-white snow and steel-grey water.

images.title: Porcelain-visored retainer
images.card: Unit, cost 3. Guard. Sworn: grows stronger each time another of your units is destroyed.
images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.continuity: The pale ceramic faceplate with its hairline crack over a steel sallet-like helmet, the dark plum long coat, the half-cuirass and the narrow estoc.
images.brief: In a long, cold gallery of an Ashen Court house, the porcelain-visored retainer has stepped into the path of someone entering off-screen LEFT, placing itself between them and a seated noble behind it, who is loosely painted in shadow. Its estoc is lowered but ready, and its free gloved hand is held out flat toward the newcomer, a silent order to come no closer. At its feet lies a second porcelain mask, cracked across, dropped by a fellow retainer who is no longer there: the reason it now stands alone. The mask's blank calm makes it unsettling, with no gore and no monster. Ash grey walls, tarnished silver and plum, and a single candle's warmth against tall, cold windows.
references: reference-library-2026-11-06/character-kits-2026-11-08/06-porcelain-visored-retainer.png: continuity for this character's mask, helmet, coat and estoc

images.title: Veil adept
images.card: Unit, cost 3. Veiled: can't be attacked or targeted until it attacks.
images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.continuity: Her face, short dark curls, angular features and lean build from the sheet. The wine-plum coat, dark shirt and the plain knife at her belt.
images.brief: In a crowded, oppressive Dominion street of soot-stained tenements and toiling people, the veil adept walks to the RIGHT through the crowd, unhurried. Shadow is folded over half of her: one shoulder, arm and the trailing side of her coat dissolve into soft, smoky darkness. A checkpoint guard looks directly past her at the people behind, and no one in the crowd reacts. Her face is calm and faintly amused, her hand resting near the knife but not drawing it. The shadow is restrained and painterly, with no glow, sparkle or device. Dirty greys, soot and bone, with the deep violet of the shadow and her plum coat as the accents.

images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.continuity: The blade's design: a plain, slightly curved single-edged sabre with a simple guard and dark leather grip, the heat banked inside the steel as a molten line along its edge. The bearer's heavyset build, mail shirt and rust-red undersleeves.

images.title: Stoneward colossus
images.card: Unit, cost 6. Guard. Can't move and can't be pushed.
images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.continuity: The colossus's design: blocky pale stone body about five metres tall, wide bronze bands at the joints, a small narrow head block in a bronze collar, and the arched opening through its chest.
images.brief: In a narrow mountain pass, the stoneward colossus stands rooted across the road like a gate that chose to be there. Arrows from an unseen force off to the left are snapping and shattering against its stone. In its shadow, three or four ordinary travellers and a soldier crouch tight behind its legs and the arch of its body, sheltering; one peers out through the chest opening. They are small, loosely painted and human-sized, so its five metres read clearly. Nothing shows how it is powered: no glowing core, no engine. Pale ochre stone, aged bronze, and hard noon sun with deep cast shadow.
references: reference-library-2026-11-06/magic-studies-round-04-2026-11-08/06-stoneward-colossus.png: continuity for the colossus's construction and scale
